name: Gramofon
scene: An antique gramophone with a flared brass horn and curved acoustic neck stands on a wooden cabinet against sweeping acoustic wave bands.
notes: Target 26–36 panes. Generated using the old gramophone as subject reference and vitray_fox/vitray_lighthouse as style references; revised once to simplify cabinet and horn. Visually inspected both attempts. Final keeps subject and background colour pairs separate and closed oval framing. Remaining doubts: slight fill shading persists; lower curved neck contains an amber/rust colour transition without black lead; some same-colour subject contacts and close horn-rim junctions need attention during tracing. Pane count and junction topology are not programmatically validated. Design sheet only, not imported into the game.
